name: io.liftoff.liftoffads.interstitials.VASTInterstitialActivity
description: Liftoff Ads opens this screen for VAST video interstitials. It plays the ad with its call-to-action, close and replay controls, companion HTML, and video progress tracking.
disableEffect: Rewards for watching this VAST video ad will no longer be granted; if the app requests one, Liftoff does not recover from a failed screen launch and the app may close.
